desc: Implement the min-heap/BFS-frontier greedy: read input, seed heap with neighbors of (P,Q), loop popping min frontier strength, absorb iff `X * strength < cur`, else break, accumulate into `cur`, push unvisited orthogonal neighbors; output `cur`.

Handle correctness details: zero-based indices, strict inequality `X*s < cur`, mark visited when a cell enters the heap to prevent duplicates, always include start cell, use Python arbitrary-precision ints for `X*s`.
Run the three provided samples and verify outputs exactly (28, 5, 1343).
Complexity/robustness check for H,W up to 500 (250k cells): O(N log N) iterative traversal confirmed.
